correctness.rationale: Before the window the record event and pattern use disjoint independent observations. After the window the insertion rank at position i is independent of the relative-order permutation at positions 1,…,i−1: each earlier permutation has one extension at each possible insertion rank. This independence is from relative order, not from the actual preceding values. Inside the window, only a pattern prefix maximum of rank s can be a record. Among the j+k−1 ranks up to the end of the window, the set of k ranks assigned to the window is uniform even given its relative order. To beat the j−1 earlier observations the top k−s+1 of all these ranks must be in that set, a probability of binom(j+s−2,s−1)/binom(j+k−1,k)=Q_s(j,k). Subtract the window's unconditional record means and multiply by 1/k! to obtain the exact formula and independence of ambient n. At fixed k, Q_k=k/j−k(k−1)/j²+O_k(j⁻³); Q_(k−1)=k(k−1)/j²+O_k(j⁻³); all lower ranks are O_k(j⁻³). Rank k always contributes and rank k−1 contributes exactly when before k. Subtracting k/j−k(k−1)/(2j²)+O_k(j⁻³) gives the stated signed limit, also for k=2. The explicit 132 numerator is 4−3j over 6j(j+1)(j+2), hence its sign switch is correct. Read the frozen verification notes and script without executing the latter; exhaustive comparisons cover k≤4 and n≤6, with separate large-position rational checks for k≤7, not a proof of the unrestricted identity.
